text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: Canary error-rate spike in eu-west-1 for /v1/generate after staged rollout of model-quant-2.1 (canary group 23). Error rate: 12.7% over 5m, threshold 5%.

alex.k: ack. i'm on it. reading logs now.

maria_p: heads-up — this was the staged rollout for quantized kernels + new batching. prioritized to canary group only. if we need immediate mitigation we can flip staged_rollout_v2 -> off.

alex.k: trying quick check — monitoring shows 503s from runtime pods hitting kernel mismatch. logs:

```
2026-03-15T21:02:11Z runtime[pod-23] ERROR kernel: incompatible kernel selected for quant profile
2026-03-15T21:02:12Z runtime[pod-23] WARN eviction: kvcache thrash
```

alex.k: i can disable the feature flag now. will call kill-switch: redwood-ctl featureflip set staged_rollout_v2 false --env eu-west-1

eng-release-bot: @alex.k scheduled feature flip: staged_rollout_v2 -> false (eu-west-1) by alex.k at 2026-03-15T21:04:03Z

alex.k: ran it, cmd output:

```
$ redwood-ctl featureflip set staged_rollout_v2 false --env eu-west-1
OK: staged_rollout_v2 set to false (propagating)
```

maria_p: checking metrics... error-rate dropping to 4.1% over last 2m. latency also normalizing. :thumbsup: 

sam.t: pinging oncall-sre: any customer-facing issues yet? CS tracking?

customer-success: a handful of 500s seen in EU tenants — ticket #CS-7292 opened, low severity, no escalations from enterprise customers yet.

alex.k: we'll keep canary paused and roll back the canary commit from the autoscaler group. running rollback job: deployctl rollback --group canary-23 --to-tag v2.0.9

devops: heads-up — rollback will trigger a small spike in pod churn; autoscaler will handle it.

alex.k: rollback started at 2026-03-15T21:09:12Z — watching.

maria_p: the KV cache eviction warnings have stopped on the pods that restarted. error-rate at 1.8% now.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: error-rate returned below threshold. Pager resolved condition cleared at 2026-03-15T21:12:45Z.

alex.k: closing the incident. action items: 1) quarantine quant-kernel test in CI, 2) add canary-stage healthcheck for kernel selection, 3) postmortem tomorrow. I'll own the follow-up.

sam.t: thx. i'll pick up handoff for night oncall and add note to ops-runbook. handing off to @sam.t for overnight watch — please ack when stable.

sam.t: acked. will watch eu-west and re-open if any regression. logging handoff in rotation channel.

eng-release-bot: Incident closed by alex.k at 2026-03-15T21:15:02Z — followup assigned to alex.k, owner: maria_p.

alex.k: thx everyone. postmortem draft will include timelines and testing gaps. :memo:
